archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Modified for Premium ESG)

brand_identity.name: Snowkap
brand_identity.tagline: We turn climate complexity into business clarity.
brand_identity.motif: The Lens - circular thin-stroke masks, circular arcs, geometric hairline lines. Images must be masked into circles or pill shapes. Deep black backgrounds to give a European, premium feel.

typography.logo_spec: SNOWKAP wordmark in clean grotesque caps. 'S' and 'KAP' in white. 'NOW' in orange (#F05A22). Use a circular arc indicator on the 'O'.

layouts.hero: Kinetic storytelling hero. Large 'Cabinet Grotesk' typography revealing 'Turn climate complexity into business clarity.' Use Framer Motion for text reveal. A circular 'lens' mask in the center showing premium nature photography.
layouts.features_scroll: cred.club inspired. Sticky section where left side stays fixed with the 'Lens' graphic, while right side scrolls through product pillars (Advisory, ESG Platform, Managed Support).
layouts.clientele_marquee: Horizontal infinitely scrolling marquee using `react-fast-marquee`. Group the logos by 6 sectors. Render client logos (JSW Steel, Daimler, Schaeffler, etc.) as clean typography-based logos or SVG icons if actual assets aren't present. Must be monochromatic (grayscale).
layouts.team_grid: Bento-style or strict Swiss grid for the team profiles. Real B/W headshots enclosed in circular masks or sharp rectangles with 1px borders.
layouts.metrics: Animated impact counters (1,100+ PCFs, 700+ suppliers, etc.) using `framer-motion` inside high-contrast bordered cards.
layouts.navigation: Sticky/Fixed top navigation (`z-50`, `backdrop-blur-xl`, `bg-black/60`). Must include 'Sign In' (links to https://login.snowkap.com) and 'Book a Demo' CTA. Include 1px bottom border.

motion.scroll: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the premium cred.club feel.
motion.transitions: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use Framer Motion `whileInView`. Parallax effects on background elements.
motion.microinteractions: Hover states on cards: 1px border illuminates (Tracing Beam effect). Buttons should scale down slightly on tap (`scale: 0.98`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the premium marketing pages. Pure HTML/Tailwind with Framer Motion is highly preferred over rigid Shadcn components for structural layouts.
Use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling (wrap the root layout in a Lenis provider).
For the 'Lens' motif, use CSS `border-radius: 50%`, `overflow: hidden`, and 1px `border-white/20` around images.
Implement the 'creds.club' style sticky scrolling for the Pillars section.
Do not use generic blue or purple colors. Only use Black, White, and the brand Orange (#F05A22).

For the clientele section, since obtaining 21 raw logo files is not feasible, render the names (JSW Steel, Daimler, Schaeffler, etc.) using stylish typography-based text logos with high-contrast neutral colors.
Include 'data-testid' attributes for all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
